commit.message:
perf(browser): cut live command pickup latency against the deployed bounded-poll edge

The deployed edge serves /v1/commands/wait-batch as BOUNDED_DB_POLL (no
LISTEN/NOTIFY wake), so the client wait budget is also the worst-case
pickup delay. main.mjs overrode the 4000ms default with 15000ms, which
was tuned for the long-poll edge design; live measurement against the
deployed edge showed p50 6.9s / max 9.8s issue-to-COMPLETED on trivial
SELECT_TAB commands (uniform pickup on the 15s poll boundary).

Lower the override back to 4000ms (the module DEFAULT_BATCH_WAIT_MS):
expected p50 pickup ~2s at one client's poll volume (~15 extra
leaseBatch RPCs/min, indexed and cheap). No behavior change once the
edge gains notify wake - an early wake ends the wait below budget.

Source contract updated to the new composition value.
